title: 【髮型視覺顧問】極簡專業髮型分析圖表：三欄式對比與臉型診斷儀
description:
Personal Hairstyle Analysis Infographic Design
A high-resolution professional "Personal Hairstyle Analysis" infographic with a clean, modern minimalist design.
Top section: Main profile portrait photo placeholder. Analysis panel titled "FACE & HAIR ANALYSIS" with clean data tags (e.g., Face Shape, Hair Texture, Key Features).
Middle section: A grid comparison chart featuring 6-9 diverse hairstyles rendered photorealistically on the same model. Strictly categorized into three distinct columns with concise icons and labels.
• Column 1 (Recommended): "BEST FIT" with a green rating icon. Styles like textured curtains, side-swept waves, short quiff. (Text labels in both Chinese and English).
• Column 2 (Neutral): "AVERAGE" with a yellow rating icon. Classic standard cuts.
• Column 3 (Avoid): "NOT RECOMMENDED" with a red rating icon. Styles like flat straight hair, blunt thick bangs, extreme high fade.
Visual Style: Soft professional studio lighting, high-quality photography, consistent facial identity, charcoal gray/sage green/beige color scheme. The layout should be highly organized without excessive overlapping or clutter.
Bottom footer: Only contains a stylized icon for "Personal Styling Assessment" and a placeholder for a generic service name (e.g., "MY STYLE ADVISOR"). NO text like "Fashion Consultation" or "High Resolution Presentation".
remark: 專為形象診斷設計。將照片分析轉化為高質感資訊圖表，含頂部臉型標籤、中部 6-9 款髮型對比及簡約頁尾。採冷色調與極簡排版，提供高度一致的視覺成品與 AI 繪圖指令。
notes:
本工具執行「結構化診斷、專業美學」規範：
• 頂部面板：臉型、髮質、關鍵特徵標籤化。
• 中部網格：BEST FIT（推薦）、AVERAGE（普通）、NOT RECOMMENDED（避雷）。
• 視覺配色：炭灰/鼠尾草綠/米色，專業攝影棚光影質感。
• 核心價值：自動產出 AI 繪圖指令，確保 8K 高清圖表中的人物面部保持高度一致。
